title: Equipment
description: An equipment item used in the OEI exercise dataset

equipment_id.description: Stable, globally unique identifier for this equipment item.

description.description: Brief description of the equipment and its common uses.

subcategory.description: More specific classification within the category.

space_required.description: How much space is needed to use this equipment safely.

cost_tier.description: Approximate cost tier. 'free' means no equipment is used (bodyweight).

portability.description: Whether the equipment is fixed in place, portable, or stationary (can be moved but not easily).

common_alternatives.description: Equipment IDs that can often substitute for this item.
